{{Quote|My rival Takara has stolen a valuable piece of surveillance equipment, which he uses to listen in on my operations.|translated=1|Ka'Pa, to Mara Jade in Huttese|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
A '''criminal organization''' was headed by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Takara]]. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] retrieved a stolen [[Global Communications Transponder]] back from the organization's [[Takara's stronghold|stronghold]] for its rival [[Ka'Pa's criminal empire|criminal empire]] led by [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to improve relations with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
[[File:Takarasfort.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The organization's fortified headquarters]]
{{Quote|Is this the best that Ka'Pa has to offer? Let's find our rat some suitable accommodations. I'm sure Takara will have some questions he'll want to ask her.|Abron Mar, to an unconscious Mara Jade|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Takara]] led a criminal organization headquartered at [[Takara's stronghold|his stronghold]],<ref name="MOTS" /> and the organization rivaled the [[Ka'Pa's criminal empire|operation]] of [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who was involved in [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trading, and arms dealing.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|198|Ka'Pa}}</ref> The organization influence covered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]] and its [[Katraasii Spaceport|spaceport]], working alongside the world's [[Dark Empire|Imperial]] presence. Its personnel included lieutenant [[Abron Mar]],<ref name="MOTS" /> Takara's right-hand man,<ref name="Features">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref> multiple [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], multiple [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], and multiple [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]. Several [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] guarded the stronghold. At some point, Takara's agents stole a [[Global Communications Transponder]] from Ka'Pa and took it to the stronghold to listen to the Hutt's plans. Meanwhile, Mar went to spend time at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] many [[Cantina/Legends|catinas]].<ref name="MOTS" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Ka'Pa eventually enlisted the help of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who in [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|exchange for supplies]] would retrieve the transponder. Ka'Pa's agents informed Jade that her best link to Takara was Mar, and Jade tracked the lieutenant to Katraasii. However, after a chase through a [[Unidentified Katraasii cantina|cantina]] and across the spaceport, Mar captured Jade and sent her back to the stronghold for interrogation. The Jedi escaped, however, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Takara's rancor]]. Afterwards, Jade battled many of the organization's henchmen, recovered the Transponder, and was rescued by Ka'Pa's agents. The transponder was then handed over to the Hutt.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mara eventually gets ambushed by a crime boss named "Takara" (and yes he's named after a particular brand of sake) and hauled off to his dungeon.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
Takara's organization appeared in the [[1998]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] developed the Katraasii-based levels that established the organization's influence and named its leader after a popular sake, a Japanese alcoholic beverage. Level designer [[Donald Sielke]] created the criminal group's headquarters.<ref name="Blog" />
